name: ai-animation-generator-free
title: 根据文本提示生成动画
description: Get animated video clips ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your text prompts or images (MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG, up to 200MB), say something like "turn my description into a 10-second animated video clip", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for content creators, students, social media users who move fast and want to create animations without drawing skills or expensive software.
title_en: AI Animation Generator Free — Generate Animations from Text Prompts
